title: LUM-PAY-007 v2.0: Change of salary bank account (2026)
text:
LUM-PAY-007 v2.0 | Change of salary bank account (IBAN) | Client procedure - Lumina Retail NV (Belgium) | Status: Approved | Last reviewed: 2026-02-16 | Effective from: 2026-03-01
Purpose: This procedure describes how a change of the bank account on which an employee receives their salary is processed for Lumina Retail NV. The goal is that salaries are always paid into the right account and that no change is made without the employee's consent.
Scope: All employees of Lumina Retail NV on the Belgian payroll (joint committee 311). Employees on the Dutch payroll follow the NL procedure.
Step 1 - Receive the request: The employee enters the new IBAN in the MyPayslip self-service portal. Requests by email, phone or on paper are not accepted: HR asks the employee to use the portal. (Responsible: Employee)
Step 2 - Check the IBAN: The payroll consultant checks that the IBAN is valid (format and check digits) and that the account holder's name matches the employee's name. If it does not match, the request is rejected and the employee is informed. (Responsible: Payroll consultant)
Step 3 - Verify the employee's identity: The payroll consultant calls the employee on the phone number already recorded in the payroll file to confirm the change. Never use contact details given in the request itself. If the employee cannot be reached within 2 working days, the change is put on hold. (Responsible: Payroll consultant)
Step 4 - Enter the change in SAP: The payroll consultant enters the new IBAN in SAP under the employee's payment information and adds the request reference in the comment field. The change is active as soon as it is saved. (Responsible: Payroll consultant)
Step 5 - Apply the payroll cut-off: Changes entered before the 15th of the month apply to that month's salary payment. Changes entered on or after the 15th apply from the next month. (Responsible: Payroll consultant)
Step 6 - Confirm to the employee: The payroll consultant confirms the change to the employee, showing only the last four digits of the new IBAN and the month from which it applies. (Responsible: Payroll consultant)
Step 7 - File the request: The request, the check and the confirmation are stored in the employee's digital personnel file and kept for 5 years. (Responsible: Payroll consultant)

text:

title: Lumina intranet HR FAQ: changed bank account
text:
Lumina intranet - HR FAQ (last updated 2023-01-10)
Q: I changed bank account. How do I get my salary paid into the new account?
A: Send your new IBAN by email to HR. HR forwards it to our payroll provider SD Worx. Changes received before the 20th of the month are paid into your new account that same month.

title: SAP workflow PAYINFO_CHG_LUM (bank account change, Lumina)
text:
Workflow ID: PAYINFO_CHG_LUM | Company: Lumina Retail NV (BE, PC 311) | Status: active since 2026-03-01
Trigger: change of Payment Information (bank account) via the ESS portal MyPayslip, or manual entry by an SD Worx payroll consultant.
Validation: IBAN check digits and account holder name must match the employee record (hard stop).
Approval: a bank account change is released to payroll only after approval by a second SD Worx payroll consultant (four-eyes). Rule active since 2025-06-02.
Call-back: field 'Call-back done (Y/N)' on the change form, optional.
Audit: every change is logged with channel (ESS / MANUAL), user and timestamp.

title: SAP control record ZPAYLOCK_BE (payment-details lock)
text:
Control record ZPAYLOCK_BE | Scope: all Belgian clients | Valid from 2026-04-01 (previous value: day 20)
Payment details are locked for the current month's payroll on day 15 at 18:00. Changes saved after the lock are queued and applied from the next month's payroll run.

title: StarGaze screen recording: payroll consultant processing Lumina IBAN changes
text:
[StarGaze capture - consented screen recording with narration - 2026-09-10 - 00:03:05]
Payroll consultant (narrating while working in SAP): This is the monthly list from Lumina HR, it came in by email again. Officially everything should go through the portal, but in practice I still get this list every month, so I enter the changes manually. For each person I first call them back on the phone number in their file, not the one in the email. Then I enter the new IBAN under Payment Information and submit it. It only goes live after a colleague approves it, SAP won't release it otherwise. Today is the 10th, so these still make the September run. After the 15th at 18:00 they would move to October.

title: StarGaze interview: former Lumina payroll consultant
author_role: Former Lumina payroll consultant (moved to Benefits NL)
text:
[StarGaze capture - consented interview - 2026-09-12 - 00:02:10]
Interviewer: How did bank account changes work for Lumina when you handled them?
Former Lumina payroll consultant: Simple. The employee emails HR and HR forwards it to us. I check that the email comes from the employee's own address, that's the verification. Then I enter it in SAP.
Interviewer: Is that still the way it works today?
Former Lumina payroll consultant: As far as I know, yes. I haven't handled Lumina since the handover in January.

title: StarGaze interview: Lumina HR manager
text:
[StarGaze capture - consented interview - 2026-08-28 - 00:01:48]
Interviewer: What happens when one of your employees changes bank account?
Client HR manager: They tell us, usually by email or they just drop by the office. We collect the changes and send SD Worx one list per month by email. I know SD Worx wants the portal now, but most store staff never log in to it.
Interviewer: Does anyone check the new account numbers on your side?
Client HR manager: No, we just pass them on. SD Worx does the checks.
